[EN] Drustan grows weary by the day. He needs rest, they all do. Their dedication prevents them from giving up or fleeing.

Perhaps they're simply too stubborn. Either way, they've kept us from certain death countless times.
[ES] Drustan se cansa día a día. Necesita descansar, todos lo necesitan. Su dedicación les impide rendirse o huir.

Tal vez simplemente sean demasiado tercos. De cualquier manera, nos han evitado una muerte segura incontables veces.
